t: This is Fore Street, in the City of London, close to the Barbican Centre. It runs from Wood Street to Fore Street Avenue, and Moor Lane joins it on the north side. German bombing in the Second World War badly damaged the street, and little of the old fabric survives; only the church of St Giles-without-Cripplegate, a short walk away, remains from before. Ebenezer Howard was born here in 1850. He went on to found the garden city movement, setting out his vision in To-Morrow, published in 1898. Letchworth Garden City, the first of its kind, was begun in 1903.
